g.text: A step costs what the busiest expert costs (top-8 of 64)

font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #475569

g.text: Left: published total and active parameter counts. Sparsity is the whole point -- DeepSeek-V3 holds 671B parameters but spends

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #475569

g.text: 37B of arithmetic per token -- and it is also the whole problem, because memory and interconnect are sized by the number you

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #475569

g.text: are not computing with. Right: simulated expert load over 40k tokens for balanced routing versus a collapsed router. Under

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #475569

g.text: expert parallelism each expert lives on its own device, so a step finishes when the busiest one does; this is what the

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #475569

g.text: auxiliary balance loss, and DeepSeek-V3's aux-loss-free bias adjustment, exist to prevent.
